articles.title: ICE Deportation Flight Carrying Iranians Turns Back and Lands in Arizona
articles.que_paso: An ICE deportation aircraft carrying Iranian nationals aborted its planned route and returned to land in Arizona, rather than proceeding to its intended stopover in Pakistan. The passengers were to be transferred onward to Iran, according to their attorneys.

articles.conclusion: The diversion highlights operational or legal hurdles in multi‑stage deportations, suggesting agencies may need to reassess routing and coordination to avoid delays or challenges.

Los ayuntamientos con aviso naranja deben cerrar parques y jardines municipales y está prohibido cruzar badenes y cauces inundados.
La Agencia Pública de Puertos de Andalucía activó su Plan de Autoprotección en nivel 2 y movilizó personal para medidas preventivas.
articles.conclusion: La suspensión de clases y el cierre de espacios públicos evidencian la gravedad del temporal, obligando a operadores y gestores a activar protocolos de seguridad y a planificar contingencias para minimizar interrupciones en servicios esenciales.

articles.title: The PlayStation Plus PC app is shutting down next month
articles.que_paso: Sony announced that it will discontinue the PlayStation Plus cloud streaming application for Windows PCs. Internal usage data showed that fewer than 0.4% of PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers were using the PC client, prompting the shutdown. The move is framed as a reallocation of resources toward experiences with broader member demand.
datos: Less than 0.4% of PlayStation Plus Premium members used the PC app.
The PC app provided cloud streaming of PlayStation games on Windows PCs.
Sony said the app will be unavailable after December 2026.
The announcement was issued by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
The decision applies specifically to the PlayStation Plus Premium tier.

"With a very small number of eligible PlayStation Plus Premium members (less than 0.4%) using the PlayStation Plus app on PC, making this change allows us to focus on enhancing high-quality experiences that more of our members want to use."
articles.conclusion: The shutdown shows Sony’s focus on trimming low‑adoption services to invest in higher‑impact features, while PC gamers will need to seek alternative streaming solutions.

articles.title: Nvidia Hires Wachtell Lipton to Investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s Affair With Chinese Executive
articles.que_paso: Nvidia engaged the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an internal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after reports surfaced of a personal relationship with a Chinese executive, prompting concerns about potential conflicts of interest and security implications. The firm appointed partner Joon H. Kim, a former acting U.S. attorney, to lead the inquiry.
datos: Nvidia hired Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz for the investigation
The investigation is headed by partner Joon H. Kim
Joon H. Kim previously served as an acting U.S. attorney
The probe focuses on an alleged affair between CEO Jensen Huang and a Chinese executive
The article reporting this was published on November 11, 2026
articles.conclusion: The inquiry could affect Nvidia's corporate governance and expose the company to regulatory scrutiny, making it essential for the operations manager to monitor any resulting policy or compliance changes.

articles.title: Despite Denial, Trump Was Told on Trip to China About Spying on Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
articles.que_paso: Donald Trump was briefed that intelligence linked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy just before Trump boarded Air Force One for a visit to Beijing. The warning came as the president prepared for a high‑level meeting with Chinese officials, highlighting concerns about potential espionage involving senior tech executives.
datos: Jensen Huang is the chief executive officer of Nvidia.
The briefing occurred before Trump boarded Air Force One.
The flight's destination was Beijing, China.
U.S. intelligence indicated Huang had a relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese spy.
The president involved was Donald Trump.
articles.conclusion: The incident underscores the risk that Chinese intelligence may target leading AI figures, prompting the U.S. to scrutinize tech executives during diplomatic trips and consider tighter security protocols.

articles.title: Spain's Ministry for Children asks the AEPD to suspend TikTok following Maldita.es investigation
articles.que_paso: El Ministerio de Juventud e Infancia, encabezado por la ministra Sira Rego, solicitó a la AEPD que imponga una suspensión cautelar de TikTok en España tras una reunión con la ONG Maldita.es y con la propia plataforma, alegando fallos en la protección de menores.
datos: La solicitud se presentó el 10 de noviembre de 2026.
TikTok había eliminado solo 5 de los 50 vídeos denunciados por Maldita.es.
El Ministerio invocó el artículo 66.1 del Reglamento General de Protección de Datos de la UE.
TikTok tiene su sede europea en Dublín, bajo la supervisión de la autoridad irlandesa.
La ministra Rego afirmó que, de haber dependido de ella, la suspensión habría sido efectiva desde el día anterior.
La AEPD puede adoptar medidas provisionales sin esperar a la autoridad irlandesa según el mecanismo excepcional del RGPD.
articles.conclusion: Esta medida subraya la presión regulatoria sobre plataformas digitales para reforzar la seguridad de menores y muestra que las autoridades españolas pueden actuar rápidamente sin depender de la supervisión irlandesa.

articles.title: ¿Qué se sabe de la supuesta espía que tuvo una relación con el CEO de Nvidia?
articles.que_paso: Jensen Huang, CEO y fundador de Nvidia, admitió haber sido infiel a su esposa con Alice Huang. Las agencias de inteligencia de EE. UU. creen que Alice Huang trabajaba para China, lo que plantea una posible vulnerabilidad de seguridad para la compañía.
datos: Jensen Huang es CEO y fundador de Nvidia.
Jensen Huang reconoció públicamente su infidelidad a su esposa.
Alice Huang está vinculada a la supuesta relación con Jensen Huang.
Los servicios de inteligencia estadounidenses consideran que Alice Huang trabajaba para China.
El artículo se publicó en medios españoles el 11 de noviembre de 2026.
articles.conclusion: El caso ilustra cómo la conducta personal de altos ejecutivos puede generar riesgos de espionaje y dañar la reputación corporativa, reforzando la necesidad de políticas de seguridad y gestión de riesgos en empresas tecnológicas.

articles.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
articles.que_paso: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang disclosed that he had an affair with a woman believed to be a Chinese spy, a relationship that U.S. intelligence and President Donald Trump were reportedly aware of. The revelation has raised concerns that the breach could compromise the supply of Nvidia’s advanced AI chips, a critical bottleneck for U.S. AI development, and potentially erode America’s lead over China.
datos: Nvidia is the undisputed leader in advanced AI chips, supplying companies such as Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI.
The United States has restricted sales of its most advanced AI chips to China to slow Chinese progress.
Emily Kilcrease, senior fellow at CNAS, warned that without the latest Nvidia chips China \"cannot close the gap with US frontier capabilities.\"
A black market for restricted Nvidia chips has emerged, offering China potential illicit access.
No public evidence has been presented that Huang directed restricted Nvidia chips to China.
articles.conclusion: If the alleged espionage leads to Chinese acquisition of Nvidia’s cutting‑edge chips, the United States could lose its AI hardware advantage within weeks, underscoring the need for tighter security and supply‑chain controls.

articles.title: Pixel phones getting new icon styles, Create My Widget, and more in November Pixel Drop
articles.que_paso: Google began rolling out the November Pixel Drop on November 11, 2026, adding a bundle of AI‑focused enhancements to its flagship phones. The update extends Gemini‑branded features such as personalized suggestions and app automation to the Pixel 10 series (excluding the Pixel 10a) and introduces new UI, widget, and wearable capabilities.
datos: The rollout started on November 11, 2026 as part of the monthly Pixel Drop schedule.
AI‑powered icon theming now includes 10 new styles powered by the Nano Banana model.
Gemini features are expanded to the Pixel 10 lineup but do not cover the budget‑oriented Pixel 10a.
Create My Widget, announced in 2026, was shipped on Googlebooks a few weeks before the November update.
HiLight notification support is added for Google Messages on Pixel 11 devices.
Pixel Watch 3 and newer receive step‑by‑step workout guidance and automatic rep/weight logging.
articles.conclusion: The update pushes more AI automation into everyday tasks, potentially boosting productivity for power users, while the limited data sources for widgets and the exclusion of lower‑tier devices temper its overall impact.

articles.title: Google’s Pixel Tag tracker is now available
articles.que_paso: Google released its own Bluetooth/UWB tracker, the Pixel Tag, on November 11, 2026, positioning it against Apple’s AirTag 2. The device is sold directly by Google and integrates with the Find Hub app, which was renamed from the previous Find My Device service.
datos: Price: $29.99 for a single unit, $99.99 for a four‑pack.
Weight: 0.4 oz, slightly lighter than the AirTag 2.
Battery life: over one year on a CR2032 coin cell.
Durability: IP67 rating (dust‑proof and water‑resistant to shallow immersion).
Connectivity: supports Ultra Wideband (UWB) and Bluetooth 6.0 Channel Sounding.
Compatibility: requires Android 9+ devices with a UWB chip or Bluetooth 6.0 for precise locating.
articles.conclusion: The launch gives Android users a native alternative to Apple’s tracker, potentially expanding Google’s hardware ecosystem and generating recurring revenue from accessories. Enterprises can leverage the UWB precision for asset tracking without relying on third‑party tags.

articles.title: Google is making Pixel HiLight slightly more useful
articles.que_paso: Google added a new notification mode to the HiLight on Pixel 11 Pro phones, causing it to flash when a Google Messages text arrives from a favorite contact, as part of the November 2026 Pixel Drop. The update is bundled with several other software rollouts, including a custom widget builder, expanded Gemini AI capabilities, workout guidance on Pixel Watch 3+, a Family Hub settings hub for newer Pixels, and the release of the Pixel Tag tracker.
datos: The HiLight on Pixel 11 Pro will illuminate for Google Messages texts from favorite contacts, announced in the November 2026 Pixel Drop.
The “Create My Widget” feature is being rolled out to Pixel 11 and Pixel 10 devices.
Gemini Intelligence on Pixel 10 now includes the Rambler transcription tool and can place calls on behalf of users.
Pixel Watch Series 3 and newer will display step‑by‑step workout instructions.
Pixel 6A and later models gain a “Family Hub” section in Settings for consolidated family‑management controls.
The Pixel Tag item tracker, first announced in August 2026, is now generally available.
articles.conclusion: The tweaks illustrate Google’s strategy of layering modest hardware enhancements with AI‑driven software across its ecosystem, giving operations‑focused users incremental productivity gains without relying on major device launches.

articles.title: Democrats Preparing Crackdown on Prediction Markets
articles.que_paso: Democrats are drafting legislation to restrict prediction‑market platforms, framing them as predatory gambling tools, and are moving forward as they regain control of Congress. The effort includes criticism from Rep. Maxine Waters and Sen. Jeff Merkley and targets firms linked to Donald Trump Jr, while a parallel AI‑regulation push is also under consideration.
datos: Rep. Maxine Waters described prediction markets as “predatory lending and predatory platforms.”
Sen. Jeff Merkley said “we need to rein in this gambling” as Democrats take back control of Congress.
Donald Trump Jr holds advisory board positions at Polymarket and Kalshi.
An anonymous former Wall Street regulator told Politico the regulatory regime could become “pretty intense.”
Politico reports Democrats are also preparing a similar crackdown on the AI industry.
The crackdown is presented as protecting consumers from predatory gambling companies.
articles.conclusion: The pending legislation signals heightened regulatory risk for prediction‑market operators and AI firms, urging stakeholders to anticipate stricter compliance requirements and potential revenue impacts.

articles.title: One of our favorite multi-filament 3D printers is $100 off
articles.que_paso: Bambu Lab is offering a limited‑time discount on its P2S Combo 3D printer bundle, which includes the P2S printer and the AMS 2 Pro multi‑filament handler. The promotion runs until December 1 2026 and is available through Best Buy and Bambu Lab’s website. This follows rising interest in reliable multi‑color 3D printing for makers and small businesses.
datos: The combo is priced at $649, representing a $100 reduction from the regular list price.
The discount is valid through December 1 2026.
The AMS 2 Pro normally costs $299 but is on sale for $229.
The P2S printer can operate up to four AMS 2 Pro units simultaneously.
The printer includes AI‑powered tools that detect printing problems and an enclosed filament handler that prevents moisture absorption.
articles.conclusion: The reduced price lowers the barrier to advanced multi‑filament 3D printing, enabling faster prototyping and more reliable production for operational teams.

articles.title: The Path to a Democratic Supermajority
articles.que_paso: Adam Jentleson, president of the Searchlight Institute, argued that the Democratic Party could increase its electoral success by adopting unconventional or heterodox positions, positioning this view as a pathway toward achieving a supermajority in Congress.
datos: Adam Jentleson is the president of the Searchlight Institute.
He said Democrats can win a whole lot more by embracing heterodoxy.
The article’s title is "The Path to a Democratic Supermajority."
The comment is framed as a strategic recommendation for the Democratic Party.
The piece provides no quantitative data or polling figures.
articles.conclusion: The takeaway is that embracing non‑traditional policy approaches may be a practical lever for Democrats to secure a larger legislative margin, a point operations leaders should weigh when planning political engagement strategies.

articles.title: Los maquinistas dan aire a Transportes: aplazan el paro del jueves en Renfe tras paralizar este martes Cercanías y Rodalies
articles.que_paso: Los maquinistas del sindicato Semaf iniciaron una huelga parcial el martes 23 de noviembre de 2026, paralizando los servicios de Cercanías y Rodalies. Tras negociaciones con el Ministerio de Transportes, decidieron posponer el paro que estaba previsto para el jueves, a la espera de compromisos gubernamentales sobre seguridad ferroviaria.
datos: La huelga comenzó el martes 23 de noviembre de 2026
El sindicato implicado es Semaf, de maquinistas
Los servicios afectados fueron Cercanías y Rodalies
El paro programado para el jueves 24 de noviembre fue aplazado
El Gobierno anunció avances para reforzar la seguridad ferroviaria
articles.conclusion: El aplazamiento del paro muestra la capacidad de presión del sindicato y subraya la necesidad de que el Gobierno cumpla sus compromisos de seguridad para evitar futuras interrupciones en el transporte ferroviario.

articles.title: Los maquinistas mueven la huelga del día 12 al 23 para tener margen de negociación tras la aprobación del decreto en el Consejo de Ministros
articles.que_paso: Semaf decidió posponer la huelga prevista para el 12 de noviembre y reprogramarla para el 23, aprovechando la aprobación por el Consejo de Ministros de un decreto de seguridad ferroviaria. La medida busca crear un margen de negociación con el Ejecutivo antes de que el texto sea publicado en el BOE y mientras mantiene la presión con otra convocatoria el 17 de noviembre.
datos: El sindicato Semaf anunció el 11 de noviembre de 2026 el aplazamiento de la huelga del 12 al 23 de noviembre.

El Consejo de Ministros aprobó el Real Decreto‑ley de medidas urgentes para el refuerzo de la seguridad operacional en el transporte ferroviario y la protección social de los profesionales del sector.
El decreto entrará en vigor tras su publicación en el Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE).
Semaf mantendrá una convocatoria de huelga el 17 de noviembre en todo el sector, además de la del 23 de noviembre.
El comunicado del sindicato afirma que es la primera vez que el Ejecutivo autoriza el decreto tras la presión de una huelga.
articles.conclusion: El aplazamiento brinda al sindicato un espacio de negociación para conseguir la publicación definitiva del decreto, lo que podría mejorar la seguridad operativa del ferrocarril y afectar la planificación de servicios en noviembre.

articles.title: The Company That Published Fake Journalists in Sports Illustrated is Collapsing Dramatically After Massive AI Rebrand
articles.que_paso: Paradium.AI, the former Arena Group, disclosed a $3.6 million net loss for Q3 2026 and saw its share price tumble about 14% to roughly $0.077 after unveiling an aggressive AI‑centric rebrand and new tools. The company blamed the loss on a sharp drop in referral traffic, a $1.3 million reversal of a tax‑credit asset, and broader industry distribution challenges, even as it reported a 15% increase in article output using AI.
datos: Net loss of $3.6 million in Q3 2026
Q3 2025 revenue was about 30% higher and generated a $6.9 million profit
Stock fell roughly 14% on the announcement, trading near $0.077
Company rebranded from The Arena Group to Paradium in August 2026
A $1.3 million employee retention tax credit was reversed and disallowed
AI tools enabled a 15% rise in article volume compared with Q2
articles.conclusion: The results show that scaling content with AI does not offset losses from traffic and ad revenue declines, highlighting the need for robust distribution strategies alongside technology investments.

articles.title: Man Sues Kalshi After Losing Over $300,000 Gambling on Platform
articles.que_paso: Scott Bright, a Bellevue resident, filed a lawsuit in Washington in September seeking $580,000 after losing about $308,000 betting on sports through prediction market platform Kalshi. Kalshi responded with a motion to dismiss on October 30, arguing its event contracts are regulated under the Commodity Exchange Act, while several state attorneys general label the platform an illegal online casino. The case emerges amid heightened political scrutiny of prediction markets following recent Democratic electoral gains.
datos: Plaintiff Scott Bright lost $308,000 on hundreds of sports bets on Kalshi
Bright is suing for $580,000 in damages
Kalshi filed a motion to dismiss the suit on October 30, asserting compliance with the CEA and CFTC regulations
New York Attorney General Letitia James accused Kalshi of running an illegal gambling operation in late July 2026
Arkansas Attorney General Tim Griffin publicly condemned Kalshi’s wagering on Razorbacks games as prohibited under state law
Washington previously obtained a court order restricting Kalshi’s operations, which took effect after Bright’s losses
articles.conclusion: The lawsuit tests whether prediction‑market contracts can be treated as regulated commodities or illegal gambling, a distinction that will shape future compliance and liability for platforms like Kalshi.

articles.title: Primeros logros de la investigación de Maldita.es: TikTok restringe dos de los términos de búsqueda que mostraban contenido de abuso sexual infantil y empieza a borrar contenido
articles.que_paso: TikTok ha limitado en España la aparición de dos términos de búsqueda vinculados a contenido de abuso sexual infantil, tras la publicación de la investigación de Maldita.es y la presentación de una denuncia. La medida afecta a algunos usuarios y variantes de la plataforma, y ha provocado la eliminación de varios vídeos denunciados.
datos: Los términos restringidos son "Pizza Seller" (y sus variantes) y "VGK".
La restricción comenzó el 10 de noviembre de 2026, cuando la búsqueda dejó de devolver resultados y mostró un aviso de posible violación de normas.
El 9 de noviembre de 2026 ambas búsquedas todavía mostraban perfiles y vídeos con contenido abusivo.
Maldita.es había señalado al menos uno de esos términos en una investigación anterior, "Depredadores de TikTok 2: un bufé libre para más de 1.300 pedófilos", hace más de seis meses.
Maldita.es presentó una denuncia ante la Fiscalía de Criminalidad Informática de España y el Ministerio de Juventud e Infancia solicitó a la Fiscalía General del Estado que investigue la plataforma.
articles.conclusion: La reacción rápida de TikTok muestra que la presión legal y mediática puede forzar cambios operativos en plataformas digitales, lo que implica que las organizaciones deben vigilar activamente el cumplimiento de normas de contenido para mitigar riesgos reputacionales y regulatorios.

articles.title: Fundación Maldita.es meets PP leader Alberto Núñez-Feijóo to present its investigation into child sexual abuse on TikTok
articles.que_paso: El presidente del Partido Popular, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, se reunió el 10 de noviembre con la Fundación Maldita.es para revisar los resultados de su estudio sobre contenido sexual infantil en TikTok. La reunión se produce justo después de que el presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, declarara su disposición a suspender la red si fuera necesario y el Ministerio de Juventud e Infancia solicitara a la Fiscalía una investigación.
datos: La investigación de Maldita.es identificó 1.183 publicaciones con abuso sexual infantil en 35 días.
Esas publicaciones acumularon 48 millones de visualizaciones.
Se detectaron más de 20.000 perfiles de posibles depredadores, de los cuales más de 7.000 estaban en español.
De los 50 vídeos denunciados a TikTok, la plataforma eliminó solo 5.
Maldita.es presentó una denuncia contra TikTok ante la Fiscalía de Criminalidad Informática.
articles.conclusion: El escaso número de eliminaciones y la denuncia judicial subrayan la necesidad de una intervención regulatoria más firme para proteger a menores en plataformas digitales. Para los operadores, implica riesgos legales y de reputación si no se adoptan medidas de control más estrictas.

articles.title: Pedro Sánchez on the Maldita.es investigation into TikTok: “If we have to suspend a social network, we will”
articles.que_paso: El presidente Pedro Sánchez declaró el 9 de noviembre que está dispuesto a suspender TikTok en España tras la denuncia de Maldita.es sobre más de mil videos de abuso sexual infantil, y el Gobierno ha solicitado a la Fiscalía que investigue la plataforma.
datos: Maldita.es documentó más de 1.000 videos de abuso sexual infantil en TikTok.
La declaración de Sánchez se realizó el 9 de noviembre de 2026 en una entrevista con Javier Ruiz en La Séptima.
El Ministerio de Juventud e Infancia pidió a la Fiscalía General del Estado que investigue a TikTok el mismo día.
La ministra Sira Rego describió los hechos como "gravísimos" en un comunicado oficial.
El presidente del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, se reunió con Maldita.es el 10 de noviembre para revisar la investigación.
articles.conclusion: Esta postura indica que el Gobierno podría usar medidas de suspensión para obligar a las plataformas a proteger a menores, lo que obliga a TikTok a reforzar sus controles de contenido en España.

articles.title: Steam Deck performance gets a reality check with Valve's new FPS data
articles.que_paso: Valve started publishing anonymized average frame‑rate data and histograms for both the Steam Deck and Steam Deck OLED on Steam Store pages, giving players a concrete performance reference that goes beyond the generic “Verified” badge and “Unsupported” labels.
datos: Valve announced the data sharing on November 10, 2026 after collecting opt‑in frame‑rate data since February 2026.
Cyberpunk 2077 shows average frame rates of 30–40 FPS on the Steam Deck, while Skyrim: Special Edition averages 50–60 FPS.
Assassin’s Creed Syndicate reaches an average of about 60 FPS on the Steam Deck OLED despite being listed as “Unsupported.”
Watch Dogs 2’s single‑player mode averages over 40 FPS on the Steam Deck, even though the game is marked “Unsupported” for multiplayer due to anti‑cheat issues.
In April 2026, JSON files in the Steam client hinted at a potential “Framerate Estimator” tool for users to predict performance on custom PC configurations.
articles.conclusion: The real‑world FPS data lets users and developers make informed decisions about game compatibility and performance expectations, reducing reliance on vague verification labels.
